audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phase whys described you winning every stage while the phases sides said Talon won the first four — and the content layer said the opposite of both.
audit.why: The lane is even-to-yours until 6 on pure range (815 ball vs 650 Rake vs 575 Noxian Diplomacy), then swings to him at Shadow Assault and first lethality item, then back at two items with Zhonya's.
audit.corrected: All seven whys rewritten to the win[] verdict with the range and cooldown reasons stated.
sources: brief enemyKit Q range 575, W range 650

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes claimed 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' and 'Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar' — the first inverts the actual level-6 swing and the second is a magnitude with no source.
audit.why: Shadow Assault is 100s at rank 1 and is his kill window on you; Command: Shockwave is 110s and does not save you from it. The flip back is Zhonya's at two items.
audit.corrected: Spike line rewritten: mana at Lost Chapter, level 6 to him, two items and Zhonya's back to you.
sources: brief ownerKit R cd 110/95/80, E cd 9

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real mechanics were never stated. Blade's End needs three Wound stacks and then a basic attack to bleed — Rake stacks it twice in one cast because the blades pass out and return. And Assassin's Path is free to cast but puts the terrain it used on a long cooldown, so a wall he has just vaulted is not available again. breakdown.cooldowns held no cooldown number.
audit.why: Both change concrete decisions: break contact before his auto lands, and treat a just-used wall as a safe side for a window.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, tradeBad, enemyWin, phases[3].why and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the Wound chain, the Assassin's Path terrain cooldown, and Rake 9s / Shadow Assault 100s.
sources: brief enemyKit W text 'return back to him... every time it passes through'
brief enemyKit E text 'puts the used terrain on a long cooldown'

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called Rake's window 'fifteen-second'. Rake is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7.
audit.why: A player waiting fifteen seconds for a nine-second cooldown gives up half his punish windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6' in a Talon matchup.
audit.why: Template leak — wrong champion on a live page, and the timing advice is exactly right for Talon so only the name was wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side values disagreed with content win[N].
